intro.text: Zetah the Voiced, a Rosharan scholar and essayist.

items.text: Zetah wrote an essay about King Elhokar swearing fealty to Dalinar as highking before leaving to try to retake Kholinar. As Dalinar worked to hold the coalition together, Queen Fen of Thaylenah obtained the essay and laid its claims before the assembled monarchs, shocking Yanagawn and Noura.
